verdict.rationale: Vanta's GRC page says controls cross-map across its pre-built or customized frameworks and that you can 'automate across multiple frameworks without extra effort' (vanta-docs-12, vanta-docs-25). The PCI page promises reused controls (vanta-docs-51), and the homepage lists SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA among 35+ supported frameworks (vanta-docs-63). This covers the core of the story, though only through short marketing claims. Missing for 10: documentation of how the overlap is shown (e.g., cross-framework coverage views), explicit confirmation that evidence credit carries over automatically between SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
